title: Priya and the Lost Red Boot

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='First snow blankets Maple Hill; Priya and her little brother Arjun climb off the sled laughing; Arjun wiggles one bare striped sock, the red boot with the yellow star is gone; Mom said be home before the streetlights wink on; fat flakes keep falling and will soon hide everything along the sled run'>>

choices.label: Ask the hill kids for help

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='Priya holds Arjun mittened hand and walks the packed sled run uphill; snow squeaks under her boots; she spots two clues, long drag marks curving off the run edge and the bumpy jump where sleds pop into the air'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='the drag marks curve toward the pine trees; a blue jay scolds from a snowy branch; at a fallen log the marks split, small paw prints hop one way and a long sled scrape slides the other'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='at the bumpy jump the snow is chewed up by a hundred sled landings; Priya digs at loose chunks with her mittens and finds a bottle cap but nothing red; nearby, small paw prints and a long sled scrape both lead toward the pines'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='the paw prints belong to a red fox; they hop neatly over the fallen log and into the blue pine shadows; Arjun grips Priya sleeve; the afternoon light is turning orange and the pines look deep and quiet'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='the sled scrape ends at a hollow log dusted with snow; inside Priya finds a striped mitten but no boot; a blue jay lands close, fluffed up and loud, hopping deeper into the pines as if it wants to be followed'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='past the log a narrow deer path threads the pines; the fox prints look fresh; Arjun toes are cold so Priya wraps her scarf around his sock; ahead rises a snowy mound with a dark round doorway, a fox den'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='the blue jay flits from tree to tree, leading them around the pines into a quiet clearing; in the middle sits a snowy mound with a dark round doorway, and on its roof rests something small and red'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='there on the den roof sits the red boot with the yellow star, half filled with snow; two pointed ears poke up from the doorway below; Priya must be gentle and quiet; Arjun presses both mittens over his mouth to hold in a squeal'>>

choices.label: Wait for the fox to leave

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='crouched behind a snowy log they watch the fox trot out, sniff the red boot on the den roof, and curl up beside the doorway; the sky is going pink; Priya counts to ten and weighs a slow brave step against a loud shoo'>>

choices.label: Clap your mittens to shoo it

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='the fox slips down into the den; Priya climbs the mound but the soft snow crumbles near the doorway; the red boot tips and starts to slide toward the dark hole while Arjun squeaks behind her'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Priya lifts the boot slow as a falling snowflake; the fox only blinks and yawns; she shakes out the snow, warms Arjun foot with both hands, and slides the boot on; they whisper thank you toward the den and reach home just as the streetlights wink on'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Priya catches the boot at the very edge of the hole and peeks inside; three fuzzy fox kits blink back at her; she and Arjun grin, back away on tiptoe, and race home with the boot and the best secret on Maple Hill'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='the boot slides into the den, too deep and dark to reach; Priya wraps Arjun foot in her scarf and pulls him home on the sled; Mom says foxes trade treasures back sometimes, so they plan to check the clearing right after breakfast'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='at the bottom of the run every sled crashes into one giant drift taller than Priya; Arjun hops on his booted foot and points at the dent where he tumbled off on their last ride; the snow is starting to fall faster'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='Priya digs at the crash dent with her mittens; the snow is packed like cold cake; she finds a scrap of yellow that turns out to be only a candy wrapper, and her fingers are getting cold fast'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='Mr. Okafor is scraping the warming hut steps; he lends Priya his small blue shovel and tucks a hand warmer into each of her mittens; back at the big drift she must pick a place to start'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='a few big scoops open a little snow cave in the drift; inside are dark shapes, a lost hat and a frozen juice box; the hole runs deeper than Priya arm can reach, and Arjun begs to wiggle inside'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='along the crash line Priya finds a boot shaped dent stamped in the snow, with a drag trough leading into the heart of the drift; the falling snow is already softening its edges, so they must move fast'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='the narrow snow tunnel opens into a hollow packed hard by crashing sleds; Arjun squeals, because under a milky crust ledge something small glows red; it is wedged in deep where the snow is hardest'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='a big scoop thuds on something hard, but it is only a frozen thermos lid; underneath it the snow turns loose and sugary, and the very tip of a red toe peeks out; the sky is getting dimmer'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='the red boot with the yellow star sits deep in the drift hole, packed in hard; one strong pull could pop it free or bring the whole drift wall slumping down; Priya braces her knees and blows on her mittens'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Arjun lies on his tummy at the hole calling left, left, there; Priya reaches until her whole shoulder is in the snow and her mitten brushes the boot heel; she can almost hook it with two fingers'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='the drift groans and slumps; a whoosh of powder buries the hole and Priya arm to the elbow; she can still feel the boot heel with two fingers while Arjun grabs her other hand and digs in his heels'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='pop, the boot bursts free in a shower of snow and Priya thumps down laughing; they shake it empty, warm it on a hand warmer, and buckle it onto Arjun hopping foot; two sets of boot prints march home before the streetlights'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='together they heave the boot out, but it is soaked and icy inside, no good for a small foot tonight; Priya tucks it in her coat and pulls Arjun home on the sled; the boot is found, and tomorrow it will dry by the radiator'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='the drift settles solid and the light is nearly gone; Mr. Okafor plants his ski pole to mark the spot and promises the drift will still be there at sunrise; Arjun rides home on the sled, one sock wrapped snug in Priya warm scarf'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='the hill kids crowd around; big Jo with the green sled remembers Arjun boot flying off near the jump at noon; Jo offers two ideas, check the lost and found in the warming hut or make a kid line and sweep the whole run'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='the warming hut smells like cocoa; Mr. Okafor tips out the lost and found basket, mittens, two hats, one green boot, but nothing red; he points Priya back toward the jump because the daylight is fading fast'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='six kids link arms and walk the run slowly downhill, kicking through soft snow; someone turns up a lost scarf; then Jo whistles, deep sled tracks and flying snow spray lead away from the run right at the jump'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='near the jump the snow is churned and plowed where the big noon toboggan train thundered through; two leads are left, the huge snow spray pile at the run edge, or the toboggan riders themselves, still sledding by the fence'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='a helper remembers the toboggan train, four sleds roped together that plowed the whole run at noon and scooped snow like a snowplow; anything it hit got shoved to the spray pile at the run edge, unless a rider picked it up'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='Priya digs through the spray pile, lifting snow clumps like giant snowballs; one heavy clump is only ice around a juice box; then Arjun tugs her sleeve and points up, a spot of red hangs in a maple by the jump'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='a rider named Sana giggles and says a little red boot bounced off their tow rope at the jump, so they hung it up high where it would not get squashed; she cannot remember which maple tree it was'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='at the tallest maple the red boot with the yellow star dangles from a low branch, swinging in the wind just past mitten reach; Arjun jumps and jumps under it while Jo comes puffing up the slope with the green sled'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='kids circle the maples shouting out every red thing, a ribbon, a bird feeder, then the real boot bouncing on a springy branch; each gust flips it a little higher, so grabbing it will take a careful plan'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='the boot pops off the branch, spins in the air, and plops deep into the soft spray pile with a poof; everyone freezes, then bursts out laughing; now it is a digging race against the dimming winter sky'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Jo boosts Priya up while helpers bend the springy branch low; she hooks the boot with two fingers and down it comes to a huge cheer; Arjun stomps his warm booted feet all the way home, telling Mom the maple tree tried to keep his boot'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='the kid crew scoops one giant crater in the spray pile and Jo lifts out the boot like a trophy; high fives go all around; walking home under the first streetlights, Priya thanks every helper on Maple Hill by name'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='digging alone takes a long, long time; Priya finally pulls the boot out just as the streetlights blink on, and they hurry home with frosty toes; the boot is found, and next time she will let the whole hill help from the start'>>
